query:
CREATE TRIGGER department_after_insert
AFTER INSERT ON departments
FOR EACH ROW
INSERT INTO department_history (
  departmentId, name, description, code, parentId, managerId, isActive, changeType, changedBy
) VALUES (
  NEW.id, NEW.name, NEW.description, NEW.code, NEW.parentId, NEW.managerId, NEW.isActive, 'created', NULL
)
